title: Sardine
wikitext: {{Infobox fish |eng = Sardine |location = [[The Beach|Ocean]] |time = 6am – 7pm |season = {{Season|spring}} • {{Season|fall}} • {{Season|winter}} |weather = Any |difficulty = 30 |behavior = Dart |size = 1-13 |price = 40 |edibility = 5 |roe = Blue }} The '''Sardine''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the ocean at [[The Beach]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during [[Spring]], [[Fall]], and [[Winter]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring, Fall, or Winter or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|40}}. Sardines can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Sardine can be found in the ocean. {{Map|275|200}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== The Sardine is used in the {{Bundle|Ocean Fish||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Dish O' The Sea|RecipeRow}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Sardine can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt259a.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sailor Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Sardines can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is blue Sardine [[Roe]].
